notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten Gates with different names in library or on the battlefield under your control.
The number of lands you control is equal to or greater than nine minus the number of unique Gates you control.
description:
Cast Boundless Realms by paying {6}{G}, causing you to search your library for a number of Gate cards equal to the number of lands you control, and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Maze's End's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, searching your library for a Gate, putting it onto the battlefield and causing you to win the game.
